title: Visual Review
description: Output contract of the visual-review skill: findings on screenshots of implemented screens, each tied to a rule and to evidence, for the human to triage and the ui-implement skill to fix. Paths are relative to the review file's directory unless --src is given for code evidence.

contract.description: Path to the design-system contract the screens were reviewed against.

accepted_before.description: The user already accepted this screen; only blocker and major findings are reported for it.

files.description: Source files that draw the screen.

rule.description: A rule id from ux-rules.md, DS-GUIDE, or LINT:<check_ds_usage rule>.

guideline.description: The contract guideline quoted verbatim; required when rule is DS-GUIDE.

observation.description: What is visible and where on the screenshot, without the cause.

ref.description: screenshot: a screenshot file of this screen; code: path:line; lint/palette: the report file.

suggested_fix.description: In design-system terms: the token, style or component to use.

confidence.description: seen: visible in the screenshot; inferred: concluded from code or a report, not visible.

siblings.description: Other files or screens where the same pattern probably exists.

decision.description: The human's triage; open until decided.

not_checked.description: States, variants or screens that were not reviewed, and why.
